cost_gate_feasibility.note: fraction of 60m bars (train+validation segments only, features available) where the S1 cost gate passes, with each symbol's own cost model; regime-dependent threshold (3x favourable, 4x tightened)

calibration.confidence_note: LOW CONFIDENCE. These numbers describe only the recorded snapshots: a few hours of one or two sessions, top 10 levels, ~15-35 s sampling. Spreads and depth vary by hour of day, weekday, volatility regime and news; a quiet-hours p90 can be far below a volatile-hours median. Hidden or deeper liquidity, queue dynamics, latency and our own market impact on subsequent snapshots are not captured. Refresh after several days covering all UTC hours before relying on them.

limitations: EXPLORATORY, UNVALIDATED results: in-sample (train) and validation only, placeholder/assumed costs, ~45 days of one market regime. Not evidence of profitability. The universe was ranked by CURRENT 24h volume (selection bias). Window ~45 days. Costs: per-symbol p90 half spread and a p90 impact curve calibrated from a few hours of recorded order books (one or two sessions, top 10 levels; NOT representative of all hours or regimes; see docs/COSTS.md); symbols without a usable calibration use the proxy model and are labelled. Fills at next-bar open/level touch; take-profits also pay taker costs. Fees are placeholders/assumptions charged in quote (Wallex fee unverified). The S1 cost gate sees the recorded full spread plus the round-trip impact at 1000 USDT. 60m bars over ~45 days give few bars per segment (S0/S1 need 50-120 bars of history first) and therefore few trades and low statistical power. Warm-up bars before each segment are excluded from metrics. Missing-minute bars are kept and counted. No parameters were tuned.
